top_signals.title: Dollar’s Rate-Fueled Rally Seen Surviving US Midterm Gridlock
top_signals.summary: The dollar’s rally may have enough momentum to shrug off the US midterm election, with high interest rates and a surge in AI-related spending drawing capital even if the vote delivers political gridlock.
